Equipment
 Alspa C 80-75 Power 
 Supply Module

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.

This 
90 Watt Power Supply 
Module is a 
rackmounted unit that plugs directly into a 48pin backplanemounted connector. 
It provides +5volt, +12 volt and -12 volt power, and logic level sequencing 
signals to the backplane.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Tawfeeq, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, 
accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan 
head sector of Nubaria power station .

This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC quality 
control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.

Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.

Caution marks must be 
 hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work place.

Because the power ON/OFF switch does not disconnect power from the internal 
 storage elements, it is possible for the input terminals to discharge to user 
 wiring when power is reapplied. To prevent this condition, turn the power 
 supply switch on after the removal of user input power to discharge all stored 
 energy through the supply.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.
This 
90 Watt Power Supply 
Module is a 
rackmounted unit that plugs directly into a 48pin backplanemounted connector. 
It provides +5volt, +12 volt and -12 volt power, and logic level sequencing 
signals to the backplane.
The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Tawfeeq, tested by 
eng. Bahaa Abd El-Wahab, revised by MDEPC quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, 
accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed Elshreif, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan 
head sector of Nubaria power station .
This document certified by eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC quality 
control general manager and MPIS coordinator and approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb 
quality control head sector.
Technical Specification :
48 VDC
Input Power:
160 watts maximum at full load
Output Power:
Output Voltage:
90 watts maximum (total for all 3 outputs)
+5 VDC: 4.90 to 5.25 volts (5.07 volts 
 nominal)
+12 VDC: 11.75 to 12.6 volts
-12 VDC: 12.6 to 11.75 volts
Protective Limits
Over voltage Limit:
Over current Limit:
+5 VDC 
 Output: 5.7 to 6.7 volts
+5 VDC output: 26 amps, maximum
+12 VDC output: 4 amps, maximum
Features
Operation from 48 VDC.
Three output voltages, 
 90 watts total,
+5 VDC output up to 18 
 amps,
+12 VDC output up to 1.5 
 amps,
-12 VDC output up to 1 
 amp,
Slidein rack mount 
 construction.
Electronic short circuit 
 over current protection provided on 5 volt bus.
Two 
 rack operation from a single power supply
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Maintenance staff should be 
 well trained and qualified.
Caution marks must be 
 hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work place.
Because the power ON/OFF switch does not disconnect power from the internal 
 storage elements, it is possible for the input terminals to discharge to user 
 wiring when power is reapplied. To prevent this condition, turn the power 
 supply switch on after the removal of user input power to discharge all stored 
 energy through the supply.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Work to be carried out
Check the supply voltage
Check the interface leds
